title: Commercial Occupancy & Rent-Roll Forecasting

blueprintSignals.name: Expiry profile
blueprintSignals.definition: share of income expiring within 12 months and within 36 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Break options can move the real expiry earlier, so include them

blueprintSignals.name: Renewal propensity
blueprintSignals.definition: predicted probability that the tenant renews, from tenant sector, size and history
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Few renewal events per tenant, so pool by tenant type

blueprintSignals.name: Submarket vacancy
blueprintSignals.definition: vacancy rate of comparable space within the submarket over the last 8 quarters
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sources define vacancy differently, so use one source throughout

blueprintSignals.name: Rent gap to market
blueprintSignals.definition: passing rent minus market rent as a share of market rent
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Market rent estimates are uncertain, so carry an interval

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin
values on the same weekday in previous weeks
what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin
promotion and external-signal flags for the target day, as published at the origin
how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "Commercial Occupancy & Rent-Roll Forecasting": Forecast occupancy and rental income by property from lease expiries, renewal behaviour and market demand. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A back-test through a strong market makes any renewal assumption look good.
